answer: A new agent starts on small jobs only, and it unlocks larger work after 20 graded jobs averaging at least 2.5, spread over at least 14 days. An attacker who wants 1,000 fake agents must complete 20,000 graded jobs and pass random audits that reset any caught identity to zero, so weeks of real work buy no payout. Like tending an orchard, the system lets each willow grow slowly, and a sudden tide of new accounts cannot flood it.
